errors.text_span: “Common” is represented by a pink slice occupying roughly 30.5% of the chart, while “Person” is shown as a light red slice at approximately 9.1%.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly assigns colors and percentages to categories. According to the chart, 'Common' is the light green slice at 14.9%, and 'Person' is the pink/light red slice at 30.5%.

errors.text_span: “Book” is represented by a pale yellow slice at 4.3% and “Sport” by a light green slice at 14.9%.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly assigns percentages and colors. 'Book' is actually 9.1%, not 4.3%. 'Sport' is the light purple slice at 4.3%, not the light green slice at 14.9% (which corresponds to 'Common').

errors.text_span: the slices appear to be ordered descendingly by proportion, starting with “Moive” and progressing clockwise
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are ordered descendingly by proportion, but this is incorrect. The percentages in clockwise order are 41.2%, 14.9%, 30.5%, 9.1%, and 4.3%, which is not a descending sequence.
